# INSTAR Lab

> INSTAR Lab Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit research institute conducting applied research in AI, quantum science, high-performance computing, health sciences, energy, space exploration, and the sciences for federal and institutional research partners.

## Key pages
- [About](https://instarlab.org/community/about-us/): Organization overview, research capacity, and governance
- [Mission](https://instarlab.org/mission/): How INSTAR frames rigorous, interdisciplinary research
- [Research](https://instarlab.org/research/current-programs/): Active research programs and translational approach
- [Sciences](https://instarlab.org/sciences/physics/): Scientific domains and AI-enabled research methods
- [Technology](https://instarlab.org/technology/computer-science/): Technical methods and capabilities
- [Tech Transfer](https://instarlab.org/tech-transfer/portfolio/): Enterprise R&D, portfolio, and STTR programs
- [Community](https://instarlab.org/community/about-us/): Leadership, careers, partnerships, and support
- [News](https://instarlab.org/news/): Research updates and editorial briefs
- [Contact](https://instarlab.org/contact-us/): Federal research, contracts, partnerships, and general inquiries

## Organization facts
- Legal name: INSTAR Lab Inc.
- Status: 501(c)(3) nonprofit research institute
- Founded: 2020
- Location: 125 Frederick St, Marietta, OH 45750-3407, USA
- Contact: info@instarlab.org, 929-229-2918
- Research domains: Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Computing, High-Performance Computing, Health Sciences, Energy Research, Space Sciences
